articles.headline: Cian never changes, and Patrick never stops changing
body: PSSST. It's Monday, the spreadsheets have been talking, and through Week 9, with 9 games in the books for every team, they named names.
Start with fortune's favorite. Jimmy is 7-2 on just 5.6 expected wins, a luck score of +1.4. And the one fortune ghosted? Patrick, 2-7 when the math says 3.6 wins, good for -1.6. Allegedly.

Now the lineup dish. Tom is getting 91% of the points available to him. Adam is getting 80%, with the league at 84%. So guess whose bench is the hottest party in town? Adam has left 302.40 points sitting there, the most in the league. Tom has left 159.37 points, the least. And the single worst night out belongs to Nick: in Week 4 he finished 62.25 points short of his best lineup, with Keon Coleman (WR) scoring 22.60 points from the bench.
Steadiest act on the carpet? Cian, with an average weekly rank of 8.0, never better than 5th and never worse than 10th. The wildest? Patrick, who has finished everywhere from 1st to 10th.
And that Week 4 trade everyone stopped talking about? Over the 6 weeks since, the players Bowie got have scored 186.30 points. The ones Cian got: 66.60 points.
That's all the gossip fit to print.

articles.headline: The Where's Waldo Bowl: has anyone actually seen Steven or Cian?
body: Scoop alert. Through Week 9 the standings have Steven 4th at 6-3 and Cian 10th at 1-8, and yes, darlings, we checked twice.

These two have not met this season. No meeting yet, no receipts, only vibes. And the vibes are lopsided: Steven's recent form reads won by 60.61, won by 38.19, and won by 3.95. Cian's reads lost by 47.07, lost by 37.80, and lost by 9.13. The points column? Steven 1456.80, Cian 1050.59. That is a 406.21-point gap. Make of that what you will.
Insiders call it The Where's Waldo Bowl: two owners who are never around, playing a game neither of them will watch, from locations neither will disclose.
“I'm 4th, Cian is 10th, and I didn't even have to pick up the phone,” Steven let slip. Cian fired back: “Nobody expects anything from me. That's exactly where I'm dangerous.”
Our vote goes to Steven, on scoring average. Cian, do prove us wrong; it would be the story of the year.

articles.headline: Bowie drops Jimmy with a 68.26-point finisher!
body: Gentlemen, the card is set. Week 9! Bowie versus Jimmy! And it was over before the bell stopped ringing! Bowie 191.95! Jimmy 123.69! That's a 68.26-point blowout! That's a clean pin!
But check the tale of the tape, because the bar tab tells its own story! Bowie has 5 shotguns on the season! Jimmy has 2 shotguns! The winner is the one hauling the heavier belt of cans!

And here's the build-up you need: through Week 9, Jimmy still sits 1st at 7-2, and Bowie is 3rd at 6-3, which means the man who got folded like a chair is still holding the top spot while the man who folded him is climbing the ropes right behind him!

Bowie grabbed the microphone: “191.95. I'd say it louder, but I'm on my fourth energy drink and the building can't take it.” Jimmy never broke stride on the ramp: “One bad night. Check who's still 1st.”
This one isn't settled. Not even close.
That's the card. See you at the next show.
